question: Identify the last element from the fifth period.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Xenon.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** The fifth period of the periodic table consists of 18 elements, starting from Rubidium (Rb) and ending with Xenon (Xe).**
 
• Helium (He) is the first element in the **periodic table and is located in the first period.** It is not a part of the fifth period.
 
• Yttrium is the first d-block element in the fifth period.
 
• ** Rubidium (Rb) is the** **first element in the fifth period and has an atomic number of 37.**
 
• Xenon (Xe) is the last element in the fifth period and has an **atomic number of 54.** Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** ****Helium (He) is a noble gas and is the second most abundant element in the universe after hydrogen. **It is used in cryogenics, welding, and as a coolant in nuclear reactors.
 
• Yttrium (Y) is a** rare earth metal and is used in various applications such as lasers, superconductors, and as a component in alloys.**
 
• **rubidium (Rb) is a** **soft, silvery-white metal and is highly reactive.** It is used in the production of photocells, as a catalyst in chemical reactions, and in atomic clocks.
 
• **Xenon (Xe) is a** n**oble gas and is used in various applications such as lighting, anesthesia,** and in ion propulsion systems for spacecraft. It is also used in research as a contrast agent for medical imaging.
